# Routing tables

**Grep this file, do not read it.** Two lookup tables sized for `grep`, not for a
context window. Match, then read that one doc in full.

```
grep -i '<a word from the failure>' docs/AI/ROUTING.md   # what am I seeing?
grep 'Scripts/Items/Artifacts'      docs/AI/ROUTING.md   # what governs this code?
```

No match is meaningful: no doc claims it. Fall back to [INDEX.md](INDEX.md), then add
the symptom once you have the answer — see [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md).
